summary: No record changed: the index has no open question, gap or source relationship whose resolution would change a judgment. I left the audit's frontier in the closing rationale instead of inventing work. The asserted defect is the witness flag in the per-cluster summary, stored but dropped on rebuild, false on both caller-visible branches, sitting on a documented query surface with no in-tree consumer, so it is a reporting defect on a client contract rather than a consensus one; it reopens only if a caller is found that reads the field for a decision or the field description changes. The snapshot-save and worker-panic accounts rest on a documented halting requirement plus the launcher execution and reopen if that launcher ever recovers panics. The snapshot install, restart, apply ordering and vote durability accounts are source- or object-level and reopen on a live-follower execution showing a different frontier or a storage layer that returns before durability. Witness eligibility reopens on any change to how quorum membership is computed, and the refusal paths reopen only if a caller reaches a node path that skips the witness admission checks. None of those conditions is present in the captured tree.
